title: You reached a machine you did not expect
fault: The scratch config sends the name practice to the decoy sshd on port 2223.
signature: a login to the wrong machine, or a host key warning
prompts: Which machine did you really reach?
What do the banner and the host key tell you?
hints: Examine the banner text after the login, and compare it with the machine you expected.
Run ssh -G practice to print the effective config values.

reveal.wrong: The scratch config redirected the name practice to the decoy sshd on port 2223 with its own host key.
reveal.fix: Verify who you reached: read the banner, compare the host key, and run ssh -G before you trust a name.
